dialogs.about: 손녀와 옛 사진첩을 보다가 새 사진을 찍기로 함

lines.en: Grandma, look at this old photograph!
lines.ko: 할머니, 이 오래된 사진 좀 봐요.

lines.en: Oh, that's your mother. I took it long ago.
lines.ko: 어머, 네 엄마구나. 오래전에 내가 찍었어요.

lines.en: Why is this one so blurry?
My hand moved then. The focus was wrong.
lines.ko: 그때 손이 흔들렸어요. 초점이 안 맞았어요.

lines.en: Let's take a new selfie today!
Good idea. Where should I pose?
Stand by the window. I will zoom in.
Is the flash on? The room is dark.
Yes. Now smile, and I will shoot.
Thank you. Let's put it in the album.
Excuse me. Can you take our photograph?
lines.ko: 실례해요. 저희 사진 좀 찍어 주실래요?

lines.en: Of course. Please stand by the red door.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 빨간 문 앞에 서 주세요.

lines.en: Is my face in focus?
Yes. Now pose together and smile, please.
lines.ko: 네. 이제 함께 자세를 잡고 웃으세요.

lines.en: The sun is bright. Do we need flash?
No. The light is good here now.
Last time our picture was blurry.
This one is clear. I will zoom a little.
Thank you very much. It captures our day.
lines.ko: 정말 고마워요. 우리 하루가 잘 담겼어요.

lines.en: Put it in your album. Enjoy the museum!
